comment:
A good workout! As others have said, lots of tree roots and rocky areas to traverse. But as one is on the crest of the Niagara Escarpment, lots of limestone “formations” are to be expected. 
Definitely not suitable for running shoes; good hiking shoes are in order. When crossing the particularly rocky areas, plan your steps deliberately and if in doubt two smaller steps are better than one larger one.
Started off strong but lots of mosquitos and other bugs

One of the best hiking days. Perfect weather. No humidity, cool, sunny, no wildfire smoke. Easy trail, slow pace today just enjoying being out in nature. Not a lot of bugs; sprayed my clothes and hat and it helped a lot. That tree in the picture; smooth as silk. Somebody had a big treat stripping that down
Awesome trail. Nature lovers would love it. Non paved trail. Perfect forest hike.
Lots of bugs, but a beautiful trail.
Bring bug spray!

Good trail through the woods, but got absolutely eaten by mosquitoes. Not bringing big spray was a major mistake. Otherwise good trail, it was relatively dry but could see it being muddy after a rainy day.
No bathrooms
Extreme amounts of mosquitoes
A bit rocky but fun

Trail is overall very beautiful. There are lots of very, very muddy spots be prepared. Wear waterproof boots other than that the trail is well-maintained. Lots to see such as bridges streams, creeks views.
Trail is abit icy right now
Gorgeous, quiet and perfect for dogs
Full of snow. Little in the way of ice at the moment. Dress in layers and get outside to enjoy the trail!
Snow and ice covered trail.  You'll enjoy the trail more if you use crampons
So quiet and peaceful.
All in the forest so well shaded.  Some rock outcrops to maneuver but not too many.
Beautiful. Perfect combination of easy and moderate.
Trail was longer than expected but nice!  Sun shines thru the trees.
Amazing trail, best sign posted trails ever. Unfortunately forgot to switch all trails off so stats are incorrect. Actual trail was 8.22 km long
Lovely hike
Good trail
Very rocky path, lot of mosquitoes . Summer hot months not the best to visit, may get hot and humid due to dense trees. No views . Hard core trek fans may like it.
The trail was almost entirely shaded, which attracted lots of bugs yet made for a wonderful adventure on a hot summer day. It’s dog friendly and you don’t have to make a reservation
Love the little boardwalk

I had a good experience on the trail—it has bit of steep rocky portions . However, it was a bit muddy since it rained the day before. I’d recommend avoiding it if it rained recently, as the path can get slippery and messy. Otherwise, it's a nice spot for a hike!
Rocky
A little bit of mud, but easy to bypass. The waterfalls and rivers are flowing great! Very few people on the trail.
Beautiful trail!
toooooooo  Muddy
Too muddy.

BEAUTIFUL TRAIL, but the first stretch sucked… lots of mud, pools of water that either the right shoes- is easy- but still annoying. It’s also just that time of year!!! Otherwise this trail is a must- the waterfalls, elevation, bridges and streams!!! Highly recommend
super muddy!!
Very muddy and icy
Lovely trail

Rocky for extended periods… caution if it sure of hoot/ poor vision

No invasive alien species.
Great network of trails through different terrains - Scotsdale Farm is a beautiful ending point
Nice fall walk
Bring poles
Great trail with moderate elevation. Well maintained, perfect for a beautiful fall hike.
Mosquitos are almost gone now.
Great trail - it was my first Bruce Trail with group. Great for solo too!
Packed soil, rocks, roots, inclines, some flatter areas,pretty streams, very beautiful and worth visiting.. Hiking boots very helpful if you wish to keep your ankles intact.
Loved this hike.  Beautiful terrain, lots of streams and mini waterfalls. One of my favourite I've done in awhile

Beautiful trail! First time I’ve gotten a stitch in a while on a hike and I’d like to say thanks to the mosquitos that gave me the motivation to improve my pace. Hope you like rocks! On that note I recommend having good supportive hiking boots or a great confidence in your ankle strength if you decide to wear trail running shoes like I did. Decently muddy in certain places but often there’s side trails around it so not too bad.
Encountered a few harmless snakes but that did not stop me from letting out a *masculine* yelp and jumping in the air every time. Perchance.
Fun fact! If you’ve spent all your energy running from mosquitoes and wonder “how much farther?” desperately enough, the all trails app will turn on to tell you there’s two more km left all uphill!

TLDR: great trail for exercise, very beautiful, decent amount of bugs
Very rocky but really fun
Parking is free. No registration is required. There are several trails you can choose in Silver Creek Conservation Area. Great scenery but many flies in summer.
Riley hiked it, it was fun and enjoyable

Being springtime, the trail was quite muddy I many places, however, did not diminish our enjoyment of our hike experience. This is a favourite trail for me and I come back often. Recommend.  AllTrails did not capture our complete hike distance/route.
muddy but so much fun! great sights and awesome scrambling. had a blast
I’ve been to this area dozens of times. It’s great. Unless you want to fall on your backside, don’t wear sneakers.
What a great trail. Easy to follow. Good for the family. A bit muddy right now... But still excellent.
Great well groomed trails are somewhat muddy this time of year, as one would expect, but the streams and falls are gorgeous.
An amazing trail! Saw a beaver
Ice cleats are a must, trail takes a bit longer with all the ice and mud. Gorgeous views!
Good trail.  Not busy.  A few icey patches going downhill.
What a beautiful trail! In loooove, and im sure you'll love it too
The one with the farm and bridge and nice river
Make sure you bring your cramp ons and you'll have a great time. Trails are icy but easy to navigate with cramp ons.
icy and snowy, be careful when going uphill or downhill. amazing views of water flowing through frozen areas.
Lovely hike, muddy on a warm winter day. Definitely going back!
Absolutely stunning. Muddy but if prepared, a great workout. True Forest Bathing. Enough people on the trail to not feel alone but still secluded.
Good parking, lots of lost and found items left along, good and various terrains and we found a raccoon on the tree
There a few areas that are easy but this is definetly moderate. There is at least 1/2 km of rocks. It is still a good walk. I have attached a photo.
Lots of mosquitoes, many challenging areas but lots of shades so won’t overheat
Lot of bugs thoughout the trail, you can’t stand still at 1 place. Trail is moderate with elevation and walking conditions
Great trail. Super buggy.
Lots of bugs! Mosquitoes, blackflies and even snakes. Bring lots of spray!
Bring bug spray!! There’s a small creek where you can dip your toes.

Smoky and buggy today. Fine as long as you have some mosquito spray and you don’t stop for too long. Otherwise, nice trail, very terrain and elevation. Quiet as well and easy access with roadside parking.
Slightly confusing, crossing over 8th and 27th several times. Nice streams along the way.
Have bug spray handy
A little muddy

We started at the creek on 27th Side Rd but there is not enough parking  space there so it's better to park  at Eight Line. Nice and easy trail with a little bit of everything. No mosquitoes due to cold and windy morning.
Good but a bit muddy from spring rainfall.
Muddy in parts
Nice hike on Easter Friday, partial trails are a bit watery, manageable to get through
The trail is very scenic and unpredictable. There are a few difficult parts but other wise it is a moderate to high intensity trail. Caution, driveway in is very rough.
Hard packed snow starting to soften, lots of slipping and sliding

Pretty decent trail for December end, a bit challenging due to the snow and frozen trail. Extreme elevation change at some points which can be challenging in snow to safely pass through. Overall a decent hike, gives you a good cardio . No bugs at this time of the season. I would recommend wearing spikes with your shoes if you are doing this in winter.
Intermediate terrain, beautiful with the new snow
Nice trail but really busy, next time I’ll probably try and get here earlier in the morning. Lots of parking on the side of the road. Moderately challenging. Trees look really beautiful!
great views amazing trails
5+ nature trail with hiking challenges and beautiful scenery especially at this fall season.  enjoy
Beautiful. A little more rugged but the kids did well. Took a cut out to reduce distance by 2km as we started late and I wasn’t sure how dark it would get.
Picturesque and calming with the stream running along the trail, but great difficulty and rocky terrain
It’s an amazing trail system with beautiful cedars interesting diversity and love the sound of the creek along the way.
Really great!
Beautiful trail! Bugs were horrible, pack spray! A few little water features the pup could cool off in. Will come back in the fall and check it out again.
Real nice and picturesque
Beautiful hike. Windy which kept the bugs away.
Gorgeous, varied terrain.
Forests, meadows, hills, waterfalls and animals. had a nice hike.

Great  I to play along and in the river. Some excellent potential side trails for another visit. Would be beautiful in winter too. Accessible from different main roads to park and start at different points. Looped back and accidentally found our car!
it’s a very peaceful trail
Muddy!
Great trail. A lot of mud, wear boots!
Beautiful, light snow fall, looks like a winter wonderland.  Recomend treking poles.
Amazing! Highly recommended.
I didn't think I could go this many km. it was great to have a friend to hike with to stay accountable with.
Beautiful trail. Sunny but cold

Tremendous trails. Incredible winter hike experience today.  Crampons needed on natural trails.  Trails traverse Snow’s Creek and Silver Creek and can be varying distances.  Open year round and a definite return location!!  Hiking and snowshoeing area.  Tremendous history of area and farm.  Escarpment glory.
Awesome hike after a fresh snow. Thankyou to the trail blazers who got there before us!
Really beautiful at this time of the year if you can bear with muddy slippery parts of the trail
Muddy  today other then that a good trail
Rockagdedon
Great trail with tons of different elevation. Rocks and stumps to keep your hiking game on too!
Excellent trail with lots of options for modifications in distances
Excellent
Lovely farm buildings, great trail!!!
Great trail with great elevation
Lovely wee hike. Not too buggy. Parking
Awesome. Beautiful all kind of terrain
Downed tree blocking the path near the point where the Maureen side trail interacts with with the Bennett heritage side trail.
Very rocky
Rocks, hills, forests, fields and a creek. Tiny little magical spots.
Good variety of terrain, went early in the morning, not busy.
Nice quiet trail. There is a significant rocky section in the middle which is tough for little and old legs.
Rocky in areas, bring proper hiking shoes. Meadows are great. Overcast and rainy mean not too many folks, which was great.
Beautiful but muddy, as expected
Gorgeous views along the streams and river. Enjoy views of the Niagara Escarpment.
Icy

lovely walk....more of a nice family stroll with daughters family on Family day.
A bit busy but still well worth it.
a lot of snow, loved it! don't forget your snow pants ;)
Nice fresh snow but too long. I started getting very tired after I crossed 8th line
it's good but cleats are necessary

It was an awesome trail! We had originally planned to do the whole loop, but we realized it would be dark before we would finish, so we took a side trail. This was such a fun hike in the winter I can’t imagine what it’d be like in the summer! Recommend this trail for sure:)

easy with some inclines - lots of photoshoots taking place at
 Scottsdale farm.
I hike here a lot since it is so close to me. Some areas are rocky with some hills. I park on the eight line which right now the colours are beautiful
So beautiful during this time of year. Highly recommend. Little streams and lots of cute bridges. Quite busy on the long weekend but still worth it.
Super nice trail, not too difficult but has some rocky areas. Not much elevation change, but you'll cross through a couple different ecosystems. Worth the long walk!
amazing trail with lots of long or short hike options. we completed the loop which had amazing challenges from flat track to elevated areas. we nice and challenging rocky section as well!!
Awesome trail!! Thanks to the Volunteers for maintaining it
Some Bruce Trail sections quite muddy and wet especially in section running parallel with road
Ontario hiking with my babe, what a breath of fresh air. Needed this hike :)
mosquitoes were out of control, couldn't finish the trail had to turn around
